after_snippet:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# In pandas 3.0, strings default to pd.StringDtype; convert explicitly
s = pd.Series(['a','b','c'], dtype=object)
assert s.values.dtype == np.dtype('O')
before_snippet:
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# In pandas 2.x, object dtype Series.values returns numpy array of objects
s = pd.Series(['a','b','c'])
# Check the old object dtype is returned
assert s.values.dtype == np.dtype('O'), f'Expected object dtype, got {s.values.dtype}'
title: DataFrame.to_numpy with dtype parameter: object dtype inference changed for string-typed DataFrames
